updates.title: More useful sales tracking
updates.summary: You can now keep better track of how customers paid, look back at earlier sales days, and get clearer guidance when using Simple POS.

changes.title: View sales from previous days
changes.detail: Open Sales and use the calendar or day controls to review sales from any earlier date stored on this device.

changes.title: Export sales for any saved day
changes.detail: Choose a date in Sales and export that day's orders as a CSV, even if you forgot to export it on the day.

changes.title: Record how each customer paid
changes.detail: Orders can now be marked as Cash, Card, Bank Transfer or QR Payment before they are placed.

changes.title: See payment types in your sales records
changes.detail: Payment methods are shown alongside orders and included in sales CSV exports for new orders.

changes.title: A clearer first-time setup
changes.detail: New users now get a short welcome explaining how Simple POS works and where their data is stored.

changes.title: What's New announcements
changes.detail: After future updates, Simple POS can show a short summary of new features the first time you open the updated version.

changes.title: Friendlier How to Use guide
changes.detail: The built-in guide has been rewritten and expanded to make setup, daily use, backups and device use easier to understand.

updates.title: Customize Simple POS for your business
updates.summary: Simple POS gained more ways to set up your products, branding and payment information, along with tools for moving your setup between devices.

changes.title: Themes and dark mode
changes.detail: Choose a ready-made theme, use Light or Dark mode, or let Simple POS follow your device appearance.

changes.title: Custom brand colors and logo
changes.detail: Use your own primary and secondary brand colors and upload a logo for the POS header.

changes.title: Product accent colors and menu notes
changes.detail: Give individual products their own highlight color and add short labels such as Today's Special, New or Best Seller.

changes.title: Reorder product categories
changes.detail: Choose the order categories appear in the POS while keeping All Products at the top.

changes.title: Import products from CSV
changes.detail: Add or update a larger product list using a CSV file instead of entering every product manually.

changes.title: Save payment details
changes.detail: Add a customer-facing QR code and bank transfer information that can be shown from the Payment page.

changes.title: Move your POS setup between devices
changes.detail: Export your products and settings as a JSON configuration file and import them into another Simple POS installation.

changes.title: Built-in How to Use guide
changes.detail: Simple POS now includes its own guide covering setup, products, payments, backups and everyday use.
